source_state: JAG1-dependent, MAML1/CANONICAL-NOTCH-dependent transcriptional output in endometrial epithelium
specificity_supported: CANONICAL-NOTCH LEVEL ONLY. Two independent knockdowns converge on SPP1: JAG1 siRNA reduces SPP1 mRNA, and MAML1 siRNA - a knockdown of the shared Notch transcriptional coactivator - also reduces SPP1 mRNA (p<0.05), while leaving LIFR, ITGB3, MAOA and IGFBP1 unaffected. SPP1 is the ONLY one of the five JAG1-regulated receptivity markers that survives that test, so the canonical-Notch attribution is specific to it and is supported by an elimination rather than by a single positive. Mechanistic corroboration: SPP1 carries an RBPJ site at -723 to -734 bp relative to its TSS. MEASUREMENT COMPATIBILITY IS EXACT AND IS THE REASON THIS RELATION IS RECORDABLE AT ALL: the target E_SPP1_EXPR is a committed node defined as 'SPP1 expression or secretion' with RNA interpretability 'direct_transcript', and the evidence is SPP1 mRNA - so section 5(2)'s activity-versus-abundance test, which defeated S_FOXO1, E_SOX17 and E_ITGA2B1, does NOT fire against this relation.
specificity_NOT_supported: NOT NOTCH3-SPECIFIC, AND IT MUST NOT BE RECORDED AS AN E_JAG1_NOTCH3 -> E_SPP1_EXPR EDGE. MAML1 is a coactivator SHARED BY ALL FOUR NOTCH RECEPTORS, so its knockdown cannot assign the SPP1 effect to NOTCH3. The assignment is actively undermined in this very paper: JAG1 knockdown INCREASED NOTCH1 and NOTCH2 NICD while decreasing NOTCH3 NICD, so a MAML1-dependent output could run through a receptor whose activity moved the OTHER way. No NOTCH3 knockdown, blockade or gamma-secretase arm exists anywhere in the paper. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: any primary-cell version of this relation - Figure 2's legend confines the whole of it, both the JAG1 arm and the MAML1 arm, to ISHIKAWA. ALSO NOT SUPPORTED: sufficiency, direction of a rate, a threshold, or protein/secreted osteopontin, none of which were measured.
system: Ishikawa endometrial adenocarcinoma line ONLY (n=6-7). No primary human endometrial epithelial cell support for this relation.
evidence: Zhou 2021 Figure 2B-C (JAG1 siRNA reduces SPP1) and Figure 2E-F (MAML1 siRNA reduces SPP1, p<0.05, and does not affect LIFR, ITGB3, MAOA, IGFBP1)
why_not_registered_there: tests/unit/test_literature_contracts.py::test_candidate_edges_resolve_to_known_nodes requires both endpoints of a row in context/literature/candidate-edges.tsv to resolve to candidate-nodes.tsv or models/specs/nodes.tsv. The source state here resolves to NEITHER: E_JAG1_NOTCH3 exists only in the quarantined staged bundle, and the honest source is not E_JAG1_NOTCH3 in any case but the broader canonical-Notch output, which is not a node anywhere. Adding either to candidate-nodes.tsv would promote a staged, catalog_only candidate (DRUNR-005) into the canonical catalog on the strength of a relation that is itself Ishikawa-only - a larger move than the evidence carries and one this increment declines. Recording it here keeps it queryable, attributed and at its true specificity without minting a canonical node to hang it on.
executable_verdict: NOT EXECUTABLE, AND NOT PROPOSED AS ONE. No rule, edge, rate, threshold or input changes. E_SPP1_EXPR keeps its committed determinant E_SECRETORY_STATE (LE016) untouched. Promoting this relation would require, at minimum: a receptor-resolved perturbation to justify naming NOTCH3, primary-cell or organoid replication, and an upstream determinant for JAG1 - which section 5(2) records as absent for E_JAG1_NOTCH3 itself.
